answer: Count backwards from the fraud to the cost. Alpine guide certification with mountain association attestation puts the cost at certification needs logged ascents verified by a mountain association, so one fake. The cedar is the asymmetry: checking takes moments and costs nothing, while fabricating takes years and costs a fortune. One imitation is affordable; a thousand are a business that loses money on every unit, and the island in each unit is a person doing ordinary work in the ordinary world. The kernel is the trail — it remembers every payment.
